transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.
Grant all privileges on all tables in the public schema to the public role

I'll help you grant all privileges on all tables in the public schema to the public role. This is typically done in PostgreSQL.

```sql
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO PUBLIC;
```

This command will:
- Grant SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, and TRIGGER privileges
- Apply to all existing tables in the public schema
- Give these privileges to the PUBLIC role (which includes all users)

Note: If you want this to apply to future tables created in the public schema as well, you should also run:

```sql
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLES TO PUBLIC;
```

This ensures that any new tables created in the future will automatically have these privileges granted to the public role.
